newsitem.title: UK: Bentalls says current sales up 10.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bentalls says current sales up 10.3 pct.

text.p: British department store Bentalls Plc said on Wednesday current sales were running 10.3 percent up on the same period last year.
Chairman Edward Bentall told the annual meeting sales were continuing at a satisfactory level in the current year.
"There has been a slight slowing in the weeks since the election, but sales are showing an increase of 10.3 percent over the same period last year."
On Tuesday the group announced a special interim dividend of 10 pence per share as a result of two property transactions.
